theorems.name: Submission.dohr_graph_tangent_planes
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (ξ : Amb n ℓ) (s R : ℝ) (Q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ), 0 < s → s ≤ R → closedBall ξ s ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 R) → Q '' ((fun x => x - ξ) '' V.support) ∩ ball 0 R = graphOver u (ball 0 R) ∩ ball 0 R → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y => V.tangentProj y) (V.weight.restrict (ball ξ s)) ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂V.weight, y ∈ ball ξ s → ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) R, Q (y - ξ) = graphPoint x (u x) → V.tangentProj y = (Submodule.map Q.symm.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (fun z : Rn n => graphPoint z (u z)) x).toLinearMap)).starProjection
